note: Measured KV-quant quality receipts (llama-perplexity A/B: fixed corpus, identical ctx/chunks/ngl, only cache types varied). `model` is the store name - the same string /api/explain/{model} resolves through the canonical ladder - so lookups match exactly; `file` records the measured GGUF for provenance. Populated by the kv-quality campaign; models without a row here have no measured receipt - the /api/explain kv_advisory reports measured: null for them rather than borrowing numbers. ppl at ctx 2048 does not cover long-context retrieval effects - see each receipt's note.

receipts.note: q8_0 and q4_0 KV deltas vs f16 are within the +/-0.22 error bars at ctx 2048 (ppl-equivalent at this ctx); long-context retrieval degradation is not covered by this receipt

turboquant fork lane: turbo3 (WHT-rotated 3-bit, ~4.3x KV compression) and turbo4 (~3.8x) ppl deltas vs f16 are +0.026/+0.010 - inside the +/-0.22 error bars at ctx 2048. turbo grades exist only on the fork lane; upstream llama-server rejects unknown cache types at load

long-ctx turbo receipt: turbo3-vs-turbo4 delta at ctx 16384 is 0.005, inside the +/-0.059 error bars. f16 was not run at 16k (does not fit this 8GiB card); turbo-vs-f16 equivalence is evidenced by the ctx-2048 receipt on the same lane. turbo at ctx 32768 dies silently on this card (2/2 repro, no CUDA/OOM trace - see artifact README); no 32k turbo receipt is claimed

long-ctx receipt: q8_0-vs-q4_0 delta at ctx 32768 is 0.017, inside the +/-0.037 error bars - q4_0 KV is quality-free at 32k on this corpus. f16 was not run: it does not fit this 8GiB card at 32k. Cross-ctx ppl values are NOT comparable (different window scale); the comparable quantities are the within-ctx deltas
OCP-FP8 E4M3 KV (upstream PR #28392, first shipped build b12284): ppl delta +0.136 vs f16 at ctx 2048 - inside the +/-0.32 error bars

long-context: f8_e4m3 ppl delta +0.141 vs f16 EXCEEDS the +/-0.07 error bars (~2x) - a real, measurable long-context quality cost on this model. This is why the grade stays pin-only: the fit ladder never auto-selects f8_e4m3; capacity-constrained operators pin it deliberately. Engine line confirms engagement (FA_QUANTS ...f8_e4m3-f8_e4m3, NATIVE_FP8 = 1)
